lessons.title: What is Natural Language Processing? 🗣️
lessons.description: Discover how machines read text, the unique challenges of human language, and real‑world NLP applications.

lessons.title: Text Preprocessing 🧹
lessons.description: Clean raw text into machine‑friendly form: tokenization, stop words, stemming, lemmatization, and regex.

lessons.title: From Text to Numbers: Bag of Words & TF‑IDF 🔢
lessons.description: Convert documents into vectors with count‑based and frequency‑weighted representations; n‑grams add context.

lessons.title: Word Embeddings: Meaning in Space 🧠
lessons.description: Learn dense vectors that capture semantic relationships: Word2Vec, GloVe, and how to use pretrained embeddings.

lessons.title: Recurrent Neural Networks & LSTMs ⏳
lessons.description: Process sequences with memory: RNNs, vanishing gradients, and the LSTM cell that remembers long‑range dependencies.

lessons.title: Sentiment Analysis End‑to‑End 🎭
lessons.description: Build a complete pipeline: preprocess movie reviews, embed, train an LSTM, and predict sentiment with >85% accuracy.
